lead: `SyntaxIndex::children_of` is not always in source order.
body: A pipeline's `$_` hole is a child whose span is the pipeline's left side, before the call that holds it, so a walk that assumes children arrive left to right picks a delimiter from the wrong call. Sort the children by `span.start` and skip one ending past the point you search from, as `crates/nvs-fmt/src/list.rs` does in `List::of`.
